levels.surface: أبي قتادة علي بن محمد بن حفص

notes: «أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link, the relation with the name alone (rule 7); the Imam is inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator
«وأبي قتادة» joins the second co-transmitter to the first in one level
«قال: قلت له» : the asker is not named and is not written; the Imam's answer is the matn
